title: Replying to @sweaty oracle IF HERE WE ARE HAS A MILLION FANS, I AM ON...
transcript: okay so I've heard some rumours going around about what's going to happen when Here We Are the final Sondheim musical closes off Broadway what is going to happen after its Broadway run I've also linked my review so here we are right here because I honestly think every single one of you should do everything you can to go see this show I'm aware it doesn't have rapping presidents or a flying car in it but some of you theatre kids should challenge yourself with this and go see it this is a difficult show this is a show that requires a lot of thinking but I trust that all of you are smart enough to work through it in your head please go see this artistic experience like no other please go see this monumental work of theatre by Stephen Sondheim it will rock your world let's talk about where it might go after off Broadway I know there are people who want this to transfer to Broadway but just trust me some things are a perfect little gem off Broadway and they will be crushed by the commercial atmosphere of Broadway look at Little Shop of Horrors as an example honestly Shucked could have run forever off Broadway it is not an insult to say some shows are not Broadway shows I don't think Here We Are it's a Broadway show I don't think David Bowie's Lazarus is a Broadway show and those are arguably two of the best nights of musical theatre I will ever experience in my life I hear Here We Are is not going to Broadway I hear it is going to do a residency at a different theatre in the United States there are rumours that it's Los Angeles there are rumours that it's Chicago but the predominant buzz going around the theatre community right now is that here we are is going to transfer to a big regional theatre in their next upcoming season 2024 2025 this will be the Joe Mantelo production I would expect at least some of the cast from off Broadway to transfer with it and wherever it goes I will be there if it goes to Chicago I will be there if it goes to Los Angeles I will be there if it ends up going to London I will be there because this is a work of theatre that demands to be seen in every iteration you can see it in I'm going to go see it again near the end of its off Broadway run because it demands to be taken in it demands to be thought about it demands to be turned over over and over again in your head I really haven't had a piece of theater glue itself to my mind like this since David Bowie's Lazarus and I really hope I get to hop on a plane and go to Los Angeles and spend the day getting at Disneyland before getting to see it in LA or Chicago or London because I want this show to go on and on and on forever thank you to the producers and the creative team of here we are for pushing to get this made after Sondheim's passing you have given us the most beautiful delicate little flower
